output: I hear you. Spreadsheets stay part of most finance workflows, and it makes sense that your board pack lives in Excel for now. Our spreadsheet add-in lets you refresh data from the platform and write changes back, so the quarterly export step can go away without you giving up the spreadsheet you already work in. We also include formatted report templates for the common board and management layouts. If your board pack needs a highly custom layout, you may still finish it in a spreadsheet, and we'll be clear about that. For example, [PROOF] Would it help to rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports together in a short working session? That way you can see where the add-in fits and where it doesn't, using your own layout.

messages.content:
<quote>
Every quarter my team exports everything to Excel to format the board pack, and I can't see that changing.
</quote>
